global_design_rules: Fusion over Imitation: Borrow from minimalist Swiss posters and elite technical command centers.
Emotion First: The HRMS should feel precise, trustworthy, and calm, not chaotic.
Negative Space: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) within cards to allow dense data to breathe.
Contrast: Sharp 1px borders, high contrast text against crisp white/dark backgrounds.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use pure colors with 1px precise borders.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: All greys/neutrals must be slightly tinted with blue.
Ensure min 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The Control Room Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Cards and containers must use p-6 or p-8 internally.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Mobile-first responsive grids. Start with grid-cols-1. F-pattern scanning: put key KPIs top-left.

surfaces_and_styles.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md).
surfaces_and_styles.headers_and_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 (light) or bg-background/60 (dark) with a 1px delicate inner border.
surfaces_and_styles.borders: Expose the skeleton for complex tables/lists using grid borders.

components_and_interactions.customizations: Remove default shadcn rounded corners. Use rounded-none or rounded-md max for a sharper, technical look. Override standard tab heights.
components_and_interactions.buttons: Primary buttons use the brand blue. Include hover states (lighter/darker hue) and focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:outline-none).
components_and_interactions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Left-aligned labels.
components_and_interactions.motion: Fast, crisp micro-interactions. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or regular weight depending on emphasis. Crisp, geometric.
icons_and_assets.charts: recharts or Shadcn chart components. Use monochromatic blue scales or distinct accessible palette for complex data.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='clock-in-btn').

media_and_images.description: Abstract blue and dark geometric shapes pattern for the auth page background.
Minimalist display of modern abstract company logo.
Portrait of a diverse team of colleagues/employee.
Four business professionals standing together indoors.

specific_functionality_instructions.login_first_time: Provide a smooth first-time login flow with mandatory password change and basic onboarding. Render the abstract pattern background.
specific_functionality_instructions.super_admin_dashboard: Focus on tenant management and billing metrics. Use North Star Metrics on top left.
specific_functionality_instructions.hr_manager_dashboard: Provide actionable widgets for pending leaves, recruitment pipeline, and punch corrections.
specific_functionality_instructions.employee_dashboard: Clean self-service portal. Display quick punch-in/out CTA, recent announcements, and leave balance summary.
specific_functionality_instructions.ai_performance_summaries: Display generative insights using an 'AI summary card' with distinctive subtle gradient or glow border (The Tracing Beam effect) to distinguish it from standard data.
